name: pkg-go
description: pkg.go.dev is the Go package and module index. This CLI uses its public JSON API (/v1) to search packages and to look up package and module metadata, versions, symbols, importers and vulnerabilities. It also reads a few server-rendered pages: package docs, the standard library listing and the golang.org/x sub-repositories.

commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search Go packages by keyword, with an optional filter expression (e.g. on import counts) and cursor paging

params.name: q
params.description: Search query (package name, keywords, or symbol such as io.Reader)

params.name: limit_value
params.description: Maximum number of results per page

params.name: filter
params.description: Go-expression filter over result fields, e.g. importedByCounts.packages > 1000 or hasPrefix(packagePath, "github.com/")

params.name: token
params.description: Page token: the nextPageToken from a previous response. Made-up values return 400.

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get metadata for a Go package (module, version, name, synopsis, latest flag, std flag), optionally at a specific version

params.name: path
params.description: Package import path, slashes kept, e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux or net/http

params.name: version
params.description: Module version, semver like v1.7.0. Standard-library versions use the v1.27.2 form, not go1.27.2.

params.name: module
params.description: Module path, used to disambiguate when the package path could belong to several modules

commands.name: get-module
commands.summary: Get metadata for a Go module (latest or given version, commit time, repo URL, go.mod presence)

params.name: path
params.description: Module path, slashes kept, e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux

params.name: version
params.description: Module version (semver, e.g. v1.8.0). Defaults to latest.

commands.name: list-module-packages
commands.summary: List the packages contained in a Go module, with an optional filter (e.g. name == "main")

params.name: path
params.description: Module path, slashes kept, e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux or golang.org/x/tools

params.name: version
params.description: Module version (semver). Defaults to latest.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression over package fields (path, name, synopsis), e.g. name == "main"

params.name: token
params.description: Page token from the previous response's packages.nextPageToken

commands.name: list-versions
commands.summary: List all versions of a Go module, with commit time, deprecation and retraction status

params.name: path
params.description: Module path, slashes kept, e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression over version fields, e.g. retracted == false or hasPrefix(version, "v1.8")

params.name: token
params.description: Page token from the previous response's nextPageToken

commands.name: list-symbols
commands.summary: List exported symbols (types, funcs, methods, fields, consts, vars) of a Go package, optionally for a GOOS/GOARCH build context and filter

params.name: path
params.description: Package import path, slashes kept, e.g. net/http or github.com/gorilla/mux

params.name: version
params.description: Module version. For the standard library use the v1.27.2 form; go1.22.0 returns 404.

params.name: GOOS
params.description: Target OS build context, e.g. linux, windows, darwin, js

params.name: GOARCH
params.description: Target architecture build context, e.g. amd64, arm64, wasm

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression over symbol fields (name, kind, synopsis, parent), e.g. kind == "Type" or hasPrefix(name, "Server")

params.name: token
params.description: Page token from the previous response's symbols.nextPageToken

commands.name: list-importers
commands.summary: List import paths of packages that import a given Go package (excluding packages in the same module), paged by cursor

params.name: path
params.description: Package import path, slashes kept, e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter expression on the importer path (variable `path`), e.g. hasPrefix(path, "github.com/kubernetes")

params.name: token
params.description: Page token from the previous response's importedBy.nextPageToken

commands.name: list-vulns
commands.summary: List known Go vulnerabilities (from the Go vuln DB) affecting a module at a given version (latest by default)

params.name: path
params.description: Module path, slashes kept, e.g. golang.org/x/net

params.name: version
params.description: Module version to check (semver, e.g. v0.1.0). Defaults to latest, which often has no known vulns.

params.name: token
params.description: Page token from the previous response's nextPageToken

commands.name: get-package-doc
commands.summary: Fetch the rendered documentation page of a package (README, doc text, repo link), optionally at a version (path@version) and GOOS

params.name: path
params.description: Import path, slashes kept, optionally suffixed with @version, e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux, github.com/gorilla/mux@v1.7.0, net/http

params.name: GOOS
params.description: Build context to render docs for, e.g. windows, linux, darwin, js

commands.name: list-std-packages
commands.summary: List the Go standard library packages with links and synopses

commands.name: list-subrepos
commands.summary: List the official Go sub-repositories (golang.org/x/...) with short descriptions

notes: The JSON API at https://pkg.go.dev/v1 is the documented public API (spec at /v1/openapi.yaml). It is rate-limited to about 45 QPS per client and answers 429 when exceeded.
Path params are import or module paths that contain slashes (e.g. github.com/gorilla/mux). Pass them as-is: do not URL-encode the slashes.

Pagination is cursor-based. Pass the nextPageToken from the previous response as --token. Invented tokens return 400. As long as nextPageToken is non-empty there may be more results, even if the current page is short.

Filters are Go-like expressions: ==, !=, <, >, &&, ||, !, plus the functions contains(s,sub), hasPrefix(s,pre), hasSuffix(s,suf) and matches(s,re). The variables are the fields of each list item, e.g. name, kind, path, importedByCounts.packages.
Standard-library versions use the module-style form v1.27.2 (go1.27.2 → v1.27.2). go1.x.y returns 404 on API routes.
list-importers may report total -1 when the count has not been computed yet.
list-vulns returns {items:null,total:0} when a module has no known vulnerabilities. The recorded example golang.org/x/net returned empty at its latest version.
The HTML /search page is disallowed by robots.txt. Use search-packages (the JSON API) instead.

The package page tabs (?tab=imports, licenses, versions, importedby) exist in HTML but were not mapped to extract fields. Use list-versions and list-importers for the equivalent data. A package's own import list is only available on the HTML imports tab.
list-module-packages with path=std likely returns the standard library packages via JSON as an alternative to list-std-packages, but this was not recorded.
